thread:
Ashley: Acme POC hit a burst of 429s during a short parallel run ~40s in. Link to redacted logs: https://acme-demo.logs/recent

Samir: can you paste the exact error and the rate headers? 429 could be per-route RPM or token-rate throttling.

acme-agent: Customer payload: "{"error":"Too many requests","status":429}"
Response headers: x-ratelimit-limit: 60, x-ratelimit-remaining: 0, x-ratelimit-reset: 14

Miguel (oncall): default /v1/generate = 60 rpm short window. Were they running parallel clients?

Ashley: yes 1 parallel agents on staging, each ~1 req/s for the minute; avg request ~1.1k tokens.

Jia: quick calc: 12-15 clients * ~60s -> ~720-900 requests in that minute. So per-route 60 rpm will trigger quickly. Token-rate might also be relevant: 15 r/s * 1100 tokens ~ 16.5k tokens/s -> 990k tokens/min (but their reported token-rate quota is usually lower).

rate-limiter-bot: Quota snapshot for org "acme-corp": monthly_token_budget=5,000,000; tokens_used_mtd=1,200,321; per_minute_token_rate_limit=20000; per_route_requests_per_minute(/v1/generate)=60.

Miguel: immediate fix is a targeted per-route RPM + token-rate bump for the trial. Sales requested 180 rpm and 40k tokens/min for the short window. Shall we apply with a 7-day auto-expiry?

Samir: applying change now: redwoodctl quotas update --org acme-corp --route /v1/generate --rpm 180 --token-rate 40000 --note "trial bump for Acme POC"
(Change q-101234)

rate-limiter-bot: Policy apply succeeded for org "acme-corp" (change q-101234). New per-route rpm: 180. New token_rate_limit: 40000 tokens/min. Auto-expiry in 7 days.

Ashley: customer re-ran; they still saw a single 429 immediately after the patch then mostly 200s.

Miguel: that single 429 is consistent with a window-edge race. Recommend also adding a temporary burst allowance to absorb parallel startup: burst_capacity=400 over 30s.

Samir: patching burst policy: redwoodctl quotas patch --org acme-corp --route /v1/generate --burst_capacity 400 --burst_window 30 (Change q-101235)

rate-limiter-bot: Burst policy updated for org "acme-corp" (change q-101235). burst_capacity=400, burst_window=30s.

acme-agent: Customer note: "errors dropped to almost zero after the bump and burst patch. Great, thanks!" :tada:

Jia: filing INF-4732 to add a short sales playbook entry: "POC quota bumps" (template includes recommended starting values, TTL, audit steps, and client retry guidance).

Miguel: SRE playbook note: for POCs with parallel startup use rpm=120-200, token-rate=25k-50k tokens/min, burst_capacity=200-500/30s. Also advise client-side jittered exponential backoff.

Samir: audit: q-101234 and q-101235 recorded. Policies auto-expire in 7 days unless extended by the sales owner.

Ashley: marking this resolved for now; will extend if customer requests. Monitoring for 2 hours. Thanks all!
